The worst!!!!! You take your pet to shower and they tell you the tag expiration they have has expired when you are there to leave the pet. Then they said I have to go get the tag and take the dog as I can’t email it. I go home with the dog and bring back the tag. Now she looks like she does not even want to take the dog and makes up an excuse that because the dog has a nut on his leg now she would need to shave him completely. She can’t even just bath him because he has a tiny nut in his right leg. This place has no respect for customers that pay their salaries. This is the reason why mobile groomers are the way to go now.

Really bad customer service, grooming staff  always try to not help walk in services such as nail services which they  do not offer appointments for.  I have no problem making an appointment, when you call they tell you to just walk in, when you walk in they ask if you have an appointment and try to come up with all the excuses in the book not to help you.
There are ways of saying things without looking very obvious to the fact that you don’t want to attend walk ins.

Petco has a great grooming option. I have taken my dogs there many many times and never had any issues. The communication once your pets are done is prompt. They take great care of my dogs and are a no stress facility, which is great for my little dog.

Absolutely great experience. Feel comfortable leaving my puppy in Tania’s hands because she is very attentive with him and you can see that she loves and cares for her furry friends. Everyone has great customer service skills and is very friendly and helpful.

Please do your doggy and yourself a favor and book with Cosette V. My friendly dog always goes happy with her as she loves dogs and she provides a good customer service. A bad experience with Cyndiann A reassured me this is the last time booking with her, she decided to cancel my appointment because she was not going to take care of my dog due time constraints as her belief was that my dog needed additional services. On top of that, as kids know best well dogs know better, my dog didn’t even wanted to go with Cyndiann. That’s all I have to say.
